research_source_registration.role: External Research Source — blind failure-learning holdouts

negative_transfer.reason: The lesson treated BlockList.rules strings as presentation-only even though Node maintainers intentionally promoted them into the public persistence contract.

useful_transfer: IPv6 completeness was correctly predicted as review-critical
invalid-input semantics and repeated fromJSON calls were correctly predicted as useful tests

candidate_negative_knowledge.statement: Before transferring an implementation-versus-semantic lesson across repositories, determine whether the target project intentionally defines that representation as part of its public contract.

evidence_summary: maintainers explicitly steered the feature toward BlockList.toJSON/fromJSON rather than filesystem coupling
review required IPv6 support, type validation, and behavior-focused tests
bounded post-merge repository search found release references rather than corrective/revert lineage
current Node.js v26.9.0 docs retain fromJSON/toJSON at Stability 1.2 release candidate
